City id boston is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=bos, city=mbta, city=boston-mbta, or city=us. Do not merge into washington, chicago, bart, or any other Next Train city. Agency MBTA. Modes v1: subway / rapid transit ONLY — Red, Orange, Blue, Green B/C/D/E, Mattapan (printed on the rapid-transit legend as M). No Silver Line BRT, no bus, no ferry, no Commuter Rail, no CapeFlyer, no Massport shuttles.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Cut #1 is Rotterdam only. Washington / Chicago / BART stay planned and untouched. This pack stays planned. assertCityLive("boston") must fail (city is not in lib/providers/registry.js — Unknown city / 400). Not in LIVE_CITY_IDS.
Timezone America/New_York HAS DST (EDT/EST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Legend on this plate: Blue Line; Orange Line; Red Line; Mattapan Line; Green Line (B) Boston College to Gov't Center; (C) Cleveland Circle to Gov't Center; (D) Riverside to Union Sq; (E) Heath St to Medford/Tufts. Four Green passenger services, not one linear Green. Mattapan is its own rapid-transit line from Ashmont (not folded into Red as heavy rail).

Locked inner-city printed name: Park Street (Red × Green). Not Downtown Crossing (Red × Orange), not Gov't Center (Green × Blue; B/C inner end), not State (Orange × Blue), not South Station, not North Station, not Haymarket, not Downtown. There is no single station on all colours. doNotGroup those downtown buildings.

125 unique passenger-open rapid-transit stops after dedupe across shared trunks. Red 22 (Ashmont + Braintree after JFK/UMass). Orange 20. Blue 12. Green B 23 / C 20 / D 25 / E 25. Mattapan 8 (Ashmont shared with Red). No unopened / future station the map does not print as open was inserted.

Map abbreviations locked (stops page often expands): Gov't Center (not Government Center); Tufts Medical Ctr; Mass. Ave; Hynes Convention Ctr; Northeastern (not Northeastern University); Sullivan Sq / Jackson Sq / Ball Sq / Magoun Sq / Gilman Sq / Union Sq / Washington Sq; BU East / BU Central; surface St / Ave / Rd family (Amory St, Blandford St, Central Ave, Capen St, Valley Rd, Fenwood Rd, Heath St). Terminus ALL-CAPS on the plate (ALEWIFE, OAK GROVE, BRAINTREE, …) is graphic treatment — D1 strings are title case as the passenger name.

doNotCollapse same-name-family pairs: Harvard (Red) ≠ Harvard Ave (Green B); Central (Red) ≠ Central Ave (Mattapan); Longwood (Green D) ≠ Longwood Medical Area (Green E); Chestnut Hill (Green D) ≠ Chestnut Hill Ave (Green B); Washington St (Green B) ≠ Washington Sq (Green C); Union Sq (Green D, Somerville) ≠ Union Sq (Allston) bus point on the same plate; Medford/Tufts ≠ Tufts Medical Ctr.

Green B and Green C terminate at Gov't Center (legend). They serve Park Street. They do NOT continue to Haymarket / North Station / Lechmere. Green D continues Union Sq via Lechmere. Green E continues Medford/Tufts via Lechmere. Green E leaves the B/C/D trunk at Copley (Prudential–Heath St) and does not serve Hynes Convention Ctr or Kenmore.

Red splits at JFK/UMass: Ashmont branch Savin Hill–Ashmont; Braintree branch North Quincy–Braintree. stations[] lists the Ashmont branch then the Braintree branch after JFK/UMass (Chicago Green south-split shape).
